description: Test file containing unit tests for Android project initialization, template handling, parameter validation, and script execution within the 'universalinit' project.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for defining project parameters such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration defining project types, e.g., Android.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Contains initialization information for templates, including build commands, environment configurations, scripts, and style.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class orchestrating project initialization based on templates and project configuration.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides templates stored in a directory, used to create specific project templates.

classes.name: AndroidTemplate
classes.description: Template class specific to Android projects, handling placeholder replacements and initialization info.

methods.name: test_android_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests basic Android project setup, output structure, and content replacement.

methods.name: test_android_template_validates_parameters()
methods.description: Ensures validation logic for Android template parameters functions correctly.

methods.name: test_android_template_basic_replacements(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies basic project property replacements in source files, e.g., app configuration files.

methods.name: test_pre_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks if post-processing scripts are executed successfully.

methods.name: test_android_init_info(template_dir, project_config)

methods.name: test_android_with_missing_template_config(temp_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures proper handling when template configuration files are missing.

methods.name: test_processing_scripts_failure_handling(template_dir, project_config)

methods.name: test_template_project_variations(template_dir, temp_dir)
